prs.title: PCE-04, PCE-06, PCE-07: possibility portfolio, capability skeleton, and the smallest honest experiment
prs.body:
Night-swarm child for issue #463. Packets **PCE-04**, **PCE-06**, **PCE-07** as one organ.

Base: `047e36c6eb0a27c3deabbba581c05e29ab597f3d` (exact PR #458 head).

## Write surfaces

- `src/personal-civilization-possibility.mjs` (363 lines)
- `tests/personal-civilization-possibility.test.mjs` (299 lines)

Exactly two new files.

## What it does

**PCE-04 — possibility portfolio.** Materially distinct families (`NON_OBVIOUS`, `STATUS_QUO`, `REVERSIBLE_TRIAL`, `STAGED_COMMITMENT`, `EXIT`, `CAPABILITY_FIRST`, `ENVIRONMENT_FIRST`), deduplicated by causal shape so cosmetic rewordings collapse while genuinely different paths survive. Each possibility records what must be true for it to be reachable, what it opens, and what it closes.

The load-bearing rule: **optionality is not automatically maximised**. A deliberate commitment that closes branches for depth, mastery, love or loyalty must not be scored as strictly worse than a path that keeps everything open. The mutation for this injected `optionality = 1 - closes.length * 0.2` — a change that looks perfectly reasonable and quietly converts commitment into a penalty — and a test catches it.

**No scalar score for a life exists anywhere in the module.** Verified by grep: no `totalScore`, `overallScore`, `lifeScore` or `combinedScore` field.

**PCE-06 — Osteogenesis.** Almost entirely composition rather than new logic, which is the honest outcome here: `src/human-capability-genome.mjs` already contained `growSkeleton` and `findBottleneck`, fully satisfying "minimum skeleton" and "binding constraint", and it already carries the character-defect guard (`DURABLE_LIMIT` requires strong evidence). The genuinely missing piece was high-transfer ranking by `unlocks` edges — preferring capabilities that open many futures over brittle optimisation for one. The rest is a thin wrapper.

**PCE-07 — experience plan.** Compiles a possibility into the smallest authentic reversible experience that would reveal whether it actually suits the person, recording reversibility, cost, time, what it would reveal and what would falsify the possibility.

`SPEND`, `TRAVEL_COMMITMENT` and `THIRD_PARTY_INVOLVEMENT` are gated behind a distinct `LIFE_EXPERIENCE_COMMITMENT` founder-authority grant — deliberately **not** reusing the core's `PRIVATE_LIFE_STATE` grant, since permission to hold private life data is a different authority domain from permission to spend money or involve another person. Conflating them would let one consent silently widen into the other.

Rest and joy are accepted with **no productivity field in the schema at all**, so they cannot be asked to justify themselves.

## Evidence actually executed at this head

```
node --check src/personal-civilization-possibility.mjs   -> clean
node --test  tests/personal-civilization-possibility.test.mjs
  # tests 18   # pass 18   # fail 0

node --test tests/life-decision-dimensions.test.mjs tests/life-autopoiesis.test.mjs tests/human-capability-genome.test.mjs
  # tests 38   # pass 38   # fail 0     (composed modules unbroken)
```

Guard-deletion mutations, file restored byte-identical after each:

| mutation | tests killed |
|---|---|
| optionality score derived from `closes`/`opens` | 1 — commitment penalised |
| experience authority gate forced `runnable = true` | 3 |
| portfolio dedupe by materiality signature removed | 1 |
| binding constraint replaced by "first gap listed" | 1 |

I re-ran the authority-gate mutation independently: forcing `runnable = true` kills 3 tests, and the file restored clean at 18/0.

## Reuse

Reused rather than reimplemented: `LIFE_DIMENSIONS` and `compareLifeOptions` from `life-decision-dimensions.mjs` for all scoring and comparison, so the no-scalar dominance logic is inherited rather than re-derived; `growSkeleton` and `findBottleneck` from `human-capability-genome.mjs` for Osteogenesis.

Newly built: possibility normalization and dedupe, portfolio assembly, high-transfer gap ranking, and the whole PCE-07 experience/authority layer, which had no prior equivalent.

Imports only modules present at `047e36c6`; no sibling-child imports, so this is independently mergeable.

## Boundaries

`businessEffectAuthority: 'NONE'` on every result. No experience self-authorizes — capability never creates authority. No real private life data in source, tests or fixtures. No life-outcome truth asserted: the tests prove the refusals hold, not that any possibility is good for anyone.

## Integration

Not merged by me. Review-ready for SOL's tribunal. Disjoint from #469–#477.

prs.title: Reachability: an operator doctor for five organs, and four kept deliberately unreachable
prs.body:
Completes the **MAKE REACHABLE** step the swarm construction law requires, for the nine organs merged in #469–#478. Based on `b71265304c01b546dc8896dd7d8bf0159f581591` (the spine head after those merges).

The reachability ratchet caught the nine new modules with no entry point and no classification. They needed two different answers, because they are not alike.

## Five get a real entry point

`scripts/sovereign-organs-doctor.mjs` exercises one load-bearing refusal per organ and exits non-zero when a boundary is gone:

| organ | boundary checked |
|---|---|
| forecast-parent-organ | 20 cases from 1 source → `REFERENCE_CLASS_UNDERPOWERED`, `baseRate` null |
| forecast-decision-boundary | EV 9,999,999 with ruin → `NOT_RECOMMENDABLE__IRREVERSIBLE_RUIN` |
| forecast-adversarial-ensemble | 10 forecasters / 1 ancestor → 1 effective vote |
| genesis-mechanism-compiler | claimed `VERIFIED_FACT` from `VENDOR_MATERIAL` → `VENDOR_CLAIM` |
| genesis-boundary-experiment | exhausted search, no mechanism → `UNKNOWN` |

It asserts behaviour rather than importing modules to prove they parse — a doctor that only imported would report health it never measured. Proven non-vacuous: with the ruin firewall deleted it returns `BOUNDARY_LOST` and exits 1.

## Four are kept unreachable, on purpose

The Personal Civilization organs are classified `DELIBERATELY_UNREACHABLE`. They compose `personal-civilization-core`, which already carries that category for a reason worth quoting:

> Holds the founder's private life state — the one data class that is not the company's. Every entry point in this repository is autonomous: the scheduler, the worker and the mesh tick all run without a person present. A path from any of them to this module would mean private life records could be read, derived from, or exported by a lane acting on its own.

Reachability is inherited, so a script reaching these organs is a path from an autonomous lane to that store.

**An earlier draft of this doctor imported them**, to check their refusals too. The ratchet failed with:

```
these modules are unreachable on purpose and something now reaches them:
  src/personal-civilization-core.mjs
Remove the entry point. Do not reclassify the module to make this pass.
```

That instruction is right, and I followed it in the direction it points: the entry point was removed, not the classification softened. Checking that a boundary holds is not worth opening it. The doctor now reports those four under `privateOrgansDeliberatelyNotChecked`, so their absence is a stated decision rather than an oversight someone later "fixes".

Their `gate` key is **absent** rather than null, per the ratchet's rule that a gate would name a condition under which wiring becomes correct — and for this category there is none.

## Evidence actually executed at this head

```
node scripts/sovereign-organs-doctor.mjs
  -> ALL_BOUNDARIES_HELD, checked 5, held 5, broken 0, exit 0

with the ruin firewall removed
  -> BOUNDARY_LOST, held 7 broken 2, exit 1        (non-vacuity check)

node --test tests/reachability-ratchet.test.mjs tests/production-coverage-ratchet.test.mjs
  -> # tests 18   # pass 18   # fail 0

live reachability: 429 src modules | 177 production | 116 operator-only | 136 no entry point
```

## Boundaries

The doctor performs no I/O, contacts nothing, and carries `businessEffectAuthority: 'NONE'`. Its own note states what it does not prove: that any forecast is accurate, any candidate is good, or that the full suite passes. No private life data appears in it — the one check that needed a private record was removed along with the import.

prs.title: ROI CONVERGENCE: current-main Forecast + GENESIS + Personal Civilization vertical loop
ROI: unbrick Vercel Deep Atlas growth + continue first-cash readiness
CASH ARTERY: PayPal provider truth → durable paid sprint → QA delivery-ready
CONSTRAINT MUTATION: evidence-triggered self-maintenance, no blind retry loop
prs.body:
Fresh current-main child originally cut from exact `799107519beca7e1dd6d56013dd937ab99b780af`.

Closes the repeated-night failure mode that still exists on current main:
- removes hourly self-maintainer cron; wakes on push to main or explicit manual dispatch;
- same objective/mechanism/provider/failure with no new safe evidence => `STRATEGY_MUTATION_REQUIRED`;
- provider/capability/authority failures produce lawful alternate strategies, not quota/account/access evasion;
- a legitimate `worker-decision-stop` remains STOP and waits for new evidence;
- blocked/rejected initial states do not automatically become blind second attempts;
- every pulse writes a continuation receipt distinguishing existing attempt, review pending, strategy mutation, clean STOP, and primary success.

### Astra/Sol tribunal repairs after the original child

Static current-head tribunal found three distinct liveness defects before merge and repaired each on this same branch:

1. **Continuation memory was advisory only.** The workflow wrote `self-maintainer-continuation.json` but did not restore or enforce it on a later pulse. Repair: exact-base continuation receipts, persistent continuation cache, and a preflight gate before ordinary maintenance.

2. **Same-base blocking needed to survive manual re-entry.** Repair: REVIEW, STOP and STRATEGY_MUTATION_REQUIRED now veto ordinary same-base re-entry; a genuinely different main SHA is new repository evidence and reopens evaluation. Continuation receipt existence by itself is not new evidence.

3. **WAIT was over-blocked.** Blocking `WAIT_FOR_EXISTING_ATTEMPT` entirely prevented UberBond from ever observing the existing worker result on the same SHA. Current head `ce1fb71239ac092c913b44ec166931bbcb1a0266` repairs that distinction: WAIT may resume **only** the exact persisted `observedIssueNumber`; WAIT without an issue binding fails closed; workflow passes the exact issue to the tick and fails if a resume-only pulse escapes to another issue. It may observe/advance the existing attempt, never create a second same-base task.

Focused tests now pin resume-only WAIT, WAIT-without-binding refusal, same-base REVIEW/STOP/MUTATION vetoes, new-base reopening, continuation restore/save, and exact-issue workflow binding. Claude Code issue #488 is independently tasked to execute/falsify this exact head locally and repair the same branch if needed.

### Hosted verification truth

GitHub Actions has repeatedly returned red checks with `steps:null` / no runner, including current head `ce1fb712...`. That is infrastructure non-evidence, not a source verdict. Exact-head executing evidence is still required before merge. Do not retry identical hosted jobs as if the color itself were evidence.

Includes pure Constraint Mutation engine, continuation policy, operator doctor, receipt compiler, preflight enforcement and hostile/static workflow tests. No customer/payment/deploy/spend/credential/life authority is added. Forbidden mutation families still include quota evasion, identity cycling, credential sharing, access-control circumvention, provider-limit bypass and impersonating authority.

Commercial/customer truth is unchanged. Do not merge until an executing runner validates the current head.

prs.title: REALIZATION: iPad-first Founder Ops control surface
C03-01: causal semantic identity without false GENESIS merges
C04-01: causal goal-specific capability bottlenecks
C03-02: bounded discriminating experiment feasibility
prs.body:
Fresh child from exact current main `84a8bb37fe435ad8e9eb27820a43a525ad103aa1`.

Astra C03-02 reproduced genuine feasibility gaps in the existing `compileBoundedExperiment` seam without replacing its mature authority/blast-radius logic: a selected probe's own cost/time could exceed top-level ceilings; caller-written `discriminating:true` could self-certify discrimination; and hypothesis+falsifier with no actual probe could still be called runnable.

This PR adds one bounded adapter, `src/genesis-experiment-feasibility.mjs`, over the mature GENESIS boundary compiler. It requires an executable probe, explicit measure, explicit decision rule, distinct supporting/falsifying observable outcomes, recognized reversibility, probe cost/time fit, unique probe identity, probe cost not understating declared spend, strict numeric/boolean effect types, and zero self-issued authority. It then delegates authority, reversibility, blast-radius and external-effect classification back to the existing compiler.

Hostile review also killed fail-open seams before integration: invalid probe-level reversibility can no longer silently inherit a safer default; malformed numeric effects fail closed; and strings such as `customerContact:"true"` cannot be interpreted as false and erase consequence authority.

A dedicated zero-effect operator doctor makes the hardened path reachable without customer/provider/production effects. Hostile tests cover missing probes, fake discrimination badges, absent decision rules, identical competing outcomes, cost/time overflow, malformed effect counts/booleans, reversibility typos, spend understatement, duplicate probe identity, preserved customer authority, and the explicit boundary that structural discrimination is not empirical informativeness.

Exact-head hosted proof at `1ceda75471423502ac64c0bdafc5273668ea6927`: CI run `34270197828` allocated Postgres, deterministic and browser jobs, but every job returned `steps:null`. Night Verification and Postal verification failed under the same hosted allocation condition. Therefore zero source executed and those reds are infrastructure non-evidence. No identical retry was launched under Constraint Mutation law.

Truth boundary: source implementation + synthetic doctor/test definitions only. No executed-test proof, real experiment, customer contact, provider call, spend, deployment, private-life observation or outcome truth is claimed.

Cross-domain transfer only counts under matched compute/tool budgets, family-by-family outcomes, protected-gate zero-regression, bounded ordinary regression, and a frozen evaluator/holdout protocol. It explicitly withholds any general-intelligence claim from a bounded panel.

VOI compares ACT NOW / OBSERVE ONE / DEFER in declared decision-local commensurable units. Observation must be discriminating, capable of changing the decision, within budget, and have net information value above alternatives. External observation requires a separate bounded-experiment/authority path. No scalar human-life utility is introduced.

prs.title: C15: distinguish discovered world resources from operationally admissible resources
prs.body:
Closes a concrete C15 evidence/operationalization gap without creating a second Capability Genome or authority constitution.

Adds a thin world-resource admission boundary over existing capability/security/effect laws. It distinguishes resource existence from current operational usability across APIs/models/compute/software/data services, human experts/operators/partners, and other resources.

Admission requires identity-bound discovery + fresh availability, explicit human consent where relevant, eligible/non-revoked Capability Genome evidence for executable resources, resolved usage/jurisdiction terms, bounded procurement authority when spend is required, observed capacity sufficient for the requested load, and requested permissions within the authorized envelope. Raw secret material is refused.

prs.body:
Hardens the already-merged C11-B/C12 truth chain one step further without changing the execution-graph owner.

Before this PR, C11-B required SHA-256-shaped `graphDigest` and `canonicalBindingDigest`, but did not independently recompute them from the compiled artifact. Normal execution had just run the generator, so this was not an ordinary source false-pass path, but it weakened receipt self-verification and left post-generation artifact mutation detectable only through secondary fields.

This PR adds `src/execution-leaf-graph-receipt-digest.mjs`, a verifier-side reconstruction of the exact owner preimages:
- graph digest = SHA-256 of exact sourceCommit + normalized requirements + leaves + topological waves + critical path;
- canonical binding digest = SHA-256 of exact sourceCommit + coverage-content digest + canonical requirement IDs + coverage row/state binding + graph digest.

C11-B now refuses unless both stored digests equal independently recomputed values. Receipt output marks the digests independently recomputed. Hostile regressions cover leaf-content mutation, topology mutation, merely SHA-shaped forged graph digests, canonical-binding state mutation and merely SHA-shaped forged binding digests.

Focused verifier-preimage tribunal: 6/6 pass, syntax clean. The previous semantic coverage-content binding remains intact. Hosted Vercel is still rate-limited and is not counted as evidence.

No runtime, customer, payment, accepted-delivery, life-outcome, deployment or ASI evidence is created. Commercial truth remains external; businessEffectAuthority stays NONE; SYSTEM_LEVEL_ASI_NOT_ESTABLISHED remains explicit.
